name: Safari
description: Tab reading, history, page summarization, and link following for Safari.

commands.title: Open Browser Tabs
commands.subtitle: Inspect active and open tabs via WebContextEngine

capabilities.name: Summarize Active Tab
capabilities.intent: Read and summarize the active Safari tab's article content.
capabilities.script: Read the active Safari page content and provide a concise summary of its key points.

capabilities.name: List Open Tabs
capabilities.intent: Show all open Safari tabs across windows.
capabilities.script: List all open Safari tabs with their titles and URLs.

capabilities.name: Toggle Reader View
capabilities.intent: Switch the frontmost Safari tab into distraction-free Reader mode.

capabilities.name: Recent Browsing History
capabilities.intent: Show recently visited pages from Safari history.
capabilities.script: Query Safari browsing history for the last 24 hours.

capabilities.name: Extract Page Links
capabilities.intent: Extract all hyperlinks from the active Safari page.
capabilities.script: Extract and categorize all hyperlinks from the current Safari page.
